The plot illustrates the relationship between model variants and metric scores, specifically precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and displays categorical values: “Full model (Ours)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The x-axis is scaled categorically with evenly spaced tick labels. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick labels increasing by increments of 2. 

A purple line represents Precision, beginning at 65.48 at “Full model (Ours)” and decreasing to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A blue line represents Recall, starting at 62.63 at “Full model (Ours)" and decreasing to 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A brown line represents F1-score, beginning at 64.06 at “Full model (Ours)” and declining to 59.67 at “w/o Attention", ending at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. All three lines are solid, with no markers present.

The description states the blue Recall line starts at 62.63, but the figure shows it starts at 65.78.

The description claims the brown F1-score line ends at 56.82. However, the F1-score line actually ends at 57.74. The value 56.82 is the end point for the blue Recall line.
The description incorrectly states that no markers are present, but the plot clearly shows circular markers at each data point for all three lines.
